patches: button-press-motion: the scale(0.98) :active transform (and its transition/disabled/reduced-motion resets) is removed, color transitions kept. references/motion.md: "Press feedback is a color step, not a scale … BoardUI buttons never shrink on press" — where the doc and the code disagree the doc wins.

React Aria interaction contract (CLAUDE.md, "The base layer's interaction contract"): renders react-aria-components Button instead of a native <button>; props are AriaButtonProps (onPress/isDisabled/isPending/slot) plus className/style; hover:/active:/focus-visible: become data-[hovered]/data-[pressed]/data-[focus-visible].
isPending (RAC): sets aria-disabled and swaps the leading icon for <Spinner> (Meridian spinner) so the label does not move.

Extra variant neutral: the grey round icon control, copied from the Dropdown usage example in references/components.md (DropdownTrigger `flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-background-secondary-default p-2 hover:bg-background-secondary-hover`, icon `size-5 text-foreground-icon-secondary`). hover/pressed ride RAC data-[hovered]/data-[pressed]; pressed is the next ladder step bg-background-tertiary-hover; disabled text-text-disabled. Size and padding stay the Button size tier. The former tertiary/danger-soft variants are removed (callers use the registry secondary/danger).
ButtonVariant/ButtonSize are exported (toggle-button.tsx composes buttonStyles).
ButtonLink is kept as the registry's native <a> (no callers).

React Aria interaction contract (CLAUDE.md, "The base layer's interaction contract"): react-aria-components Button (Dialog slot="close", TooltipTrigger child); hover:/focus-visible: → data-[hovered]/data-[focus-visible]; props are AriaButtonProps.
input/label.tsx: the registry drops isInvalid (`isInvalid: _isInvalid`); an eslint-disable for meridian-ui/no-silent-prop-drop documents that, code unchanged.
Icons: keyline two-tone replaces @remixicon/react (project icon decision 2026-09-23)
React Aria interaction contract (CLAUDE.md, "The base layer's interaction contract"): trigger hover:/focus-visible: → data-[hovered]/data-[focus-visible] (menu-styles MENU_ITEM_INTERACTIVE likewise).

label / description props render the registry's own input/label Label and input/hint-text HintText inside the RAC Select (named/described trigger); root gets gap-1 like TextField. Used by settings primitives and hooks settings.

React Aria interaction contract (CLAUDE.md, "The base layer's interaction contract"): the registry panel is DialogTrigger + native <button> rows (no role=menu, arrow keys, typeahead or selection). Here: Dropdown = MenuTrigger, DropdownPopover = Popover + Menu (menu props pass through: selectionMode, selectedKeys, onAction…), DropdownGroup = MenuSection + Header, DropdownItem = MenuItem (onAction instead of onSelect, selection from the menu instead of `selected`), DropdownDivider = Separator. MenuTrigger owns dismissal, so the isNonModal + useDismissOnOutsidePress bridge is not used. Surface and row classes unchanged.
menu-styles MENU_ITEM_INTERACTIVE: hover:/focus-visible: → data-[hovered]/data-[focus-visible].
DropdownItem variant="danger" (row-actions-menu destructive actions): text-text-error-primary; isDisabled rows: cursor-not-allowed text-text-disabled.
React Aria interaction contract (CLAUDE.md, "The base layer's interaction contract"): SegmentedControlItem (RAC ToggleButton) hover:/focus-visible: → data-[hovered]/data-[focus-visible].

React Aria interaction contract (CLAUDE.md, "The base layer's interaction contract"): Tab/TabPanel focus-visible: → data-[focus-visible]; PillTab is a react-aria-components Button (onPress, group-data-[hovered]) instead of a native <button onClick>.
Draws children (a model glyph) in place of initials, and falls back to them when the photo fails to load (onError) — message-item.tsx; contract-tested.
The registry's `/* eslint-disable @next/next/no-img-element */` header is dropped: no Next ESLint plugin here, and ESLint errors on an unknown rule.

React Aria interaction contract (CLAUDE.md, "The base layer's interaction contract"): Button and CloseButton are RAC here, so the action buttons and the close button are wired with onPress instead of onClick, and NotificationAction.onClick is renamed onPress to match.
Icons: keyline /fill replaces @remixicon/react (project icon decision 2026-09-23): neutral Bell, information Info, success CircleCheck, error CircleAlert.

React Aria interaction contract (CLAUDE.md, "The base layer's interaction contract"): Button is RAC here, so "Mark all read" and the row actions are wired with onPress/isDisabled instead of onClick/disabled.

Icons: keyline replaces @remixicon/react (project icon decision 2026-09-23): status glyphs are /fill (neutral Bell, information Info, success CircleCheck, error CircleAlert); the empty state's outline RiNotificationOffLine is two-tone BellOff.

i18n (user ruling 2026-09-23): the hard-coded English — "N unread", "No unread notifications", "Mark all read", the empty state's second line, the dot's "Unread" aria-label and the SegmentedControl's "Notification category" aria-label — reads from an optional `labels` prop (Partial<NotificationCenterLabels>). DEFAULT_LABELS holds the registry's exact strings, so an uncustomised call renders what the registry does. `title` and `emptyMessage` were already props.

Tabs (user ruling 2026-09-23): an optional `tabs` prop replaces the fixed TABS constant (default: the registry's All/Mentions/System). `all` lists everything and any other id filters on `category`, which is how the three registry tabs already behaved; tab counts are computed from the same list. To let a caller name its own categories, `category`, `tab`, `defaultTab` and `onTabChange` widen to `NotificationCenterTabId` (the registry union | string).

Read state (user ruling 2026-09-23): an optional `readable` prop, default true. `readable={false}` removes the internal readIds bookkeeping and the "Mark all read" button, so the dot means exactly what `item.unread` says. Meridian's inbox lists questions waiting on a person: they are never "read", only answered, and an answered one leaves the list.

description widens from string to ReactNode (Meridian need): the inbox draws the same call summary as the approval notification (ToolArgsSummary with its whitespace-pre-wrap command). As a plain string a multi-line command would render with its newlines collapsed, and the decision rules require that what is approved is shown as it will run.

Groups (user ruling 2026-09-23): an optional `showGroups` prop, default false (the registry's flat list). When true the visible list is stably reordered so each `group` sits where its first item stood, items keep their order within it, and a label is drawn before each group's first item — `

`, the registry's own group label from agent-chat-history ("Recent"). The rows are wrapped in a keyed Fragment for that label; the article itself is unchanged. Meridian's inbox turns it on to list questions under their conversation.

Partial install: of the registry app-shell item only notification-bell.tsx is vendored — the header bell that opens NotificationCenter. The shell, catalog, starter data and the rest are not used here, so drift lists them as "registry now also ships".

React Aria interaction contract + user ruling 2026-09-23: the registry IconButton (native <button>, white bordered square) is replaced by the base RAC Button as the project's icon-only control — iconOnly, variant="neutral" (the grey round control), size small with className "size-11 md:size-8" to match the header's other icon buttons — wired with onPress. ref, aria-expanded and aria-haspopup are passed exactly as before.
Icons: keyline two-tone Bell replaces the line glyph RiNotificationLine (project icon decision 2026-09-23).

Data (Meridian need): `notifications` is required and STARTER_NOTIFICATIONS (demo data) is not installed; `centerProps` passes the center everything besides its items (tabs, labels, readable, title, emptyMessage, onAction); `before` renders a node inside the dialog above the center (the "this conversation has N pending" line); `isOpen`/`onOpenChange` make the open state optionally controlled so an action that navigates away can close it. Uncontrolled it behaves as the registry's.
i18n (user ruling 2026-09-23): `triggerLabel` and `dialogLabel` replace the two hard-coded "Notifications" aria-labels; both default to the registry's string.

Motion: OVERLAY_MOTION (components/base/overlay-motion.ts) is added to the Popover className through cx. motion.md: popovers fade + scale-95 + 2px blur over 150ms; the registry bell's popover ships no transition, and where BoardUI's documents and its code disagree the documents win (CLAUDE.md, UI Conventions).

Badge (user ruling 2026-09-23): a count over 99 is drawn as `99+`; the badge is `h-4 min-w-4 px-0.5` instead of `size-4` (inner span loses `w-4`) so it widens with its content, colours, border and type unchanged. It is positioned from the button's centre — `top-1/2 right-1/2 -mt-3.5 -mr-4.5` — instead of `top-0.5 left-[18px]`: identical to the registry at the 32px size (top 2px, right edge 34px) and at the glyph's top-right corner at 44px too, where the fixed left offset put it over the glyph's middle. Wider content grows leftward over the glyph rather than out of the button.
